title: test(gen): assert finish_reason=error keeps choice.error.message
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Test that streaming `finish_reason: "error"` keeps `choice.error.message` in tracking.
- The runtime fix is already merged in #14999; this PR adds only regression coverage.

Addresses #14994
Fixes #15412

## Test plan
- [x] `npx vitest run test/tracking-observability.test.ts -t "choice.error.message"` (1 passed).
- [x] Biome check on the touched config file.

gist.headline: Error Messages Stay Put
gist.blurb: A regression test now keeps watch while streaming errors carry their useful message all the way into tracking. The bees have filed the receipt.
gist.summary: Added regression coverage in gen.pollinations.ai to verify that streaming responses with finish_reason: "error" retain choice.error.message in tracking observability.
gist.impact: Developers can rely on tracking records preserving the original streaming error message when this failure path occurs.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observability scene: Polli, wearing tiny inspector glasses, checks a glowing error-message note travelling intact from a retro streaming terminal into a labeled tracking jar, with small code-plants nearby. This is test-only regression coverage, so the image should emphasize careful verification rather than a new feature.
